content: 第四关（前）
Waaahhh...
I'm hungry!

content: Where's daddy? Where did he go?

content: I want my daddy...! Daddy! Daddyyy!
Daddy will come get me!

speaker: GreyThroat
content: A child?

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  Blaze-4, Amiya-1, come in. I'm in the slums. 4th Street, building number 10. There's a child survivor, Infected.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: Blaze-4, Amiya-1, come in. I'm in the slums. 4th Street, building number 10. There's a child survivor, Infected.

speaker: Child
content: Waaahhh...

speaker: GreyThroat
content: ...Hello.

speaker: Child
content: Wh- who are you?

speaker: Child
content: Are you a Lungmenite?

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  I will not hurt you. I don't speak Ursine well. I am not an enemy.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: I will not hurt you. I don't speak Ursine well. I am not an enemy.

speaker: Child
content: What did you say?

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  Come with me. It is dangerous here.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: Come with me. It is dangerous here.

raw: [name="Child"]  I can't... Uncle said to stay here.
speaker: Child
content: I can't... Uncle said to stay here.

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  But I will take you to find your dad.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: But I will take you to find your dad.

speaker: Child
content: You can do that?

speaker: GreyThroat
content: I can do that.

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  You, hiding behind me, come out.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: You, hiding behind me, come out.

speaker: Reunion Member
content: You're...

speaker: Reunion Member
content: You're not with them.

speaker: Reunion Member
content: You're... from Rhodes Island?

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  Child, stay back. Don't come closer.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: Child, stay back. Don't come closer.

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  Drop your weapon and come out with your hands up.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: Drop your weapon and come out with your hands up.

speaker: Reunion Member
content: What?

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  You're not here to save us?
speaker: Reunion Member
content: You're not here to save us?

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Don't you Rhodes Islanders know what's hidden here?
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Don't you Rhodes Islanders know what's hidden here?

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  We worked hard to set up this ambush... If we can't lure them in, if we can't take them out, they'll kill all of us!
speaker: Reunion Member
content: We worked hard to set up this ambush... If we can't lure them in, if we can't take them out, they'll kill all of us!

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  You're using children as bait. You deserve to be killed.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: You're using children as bait. You deserve to be killed.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  You think this will end when we're dead?
speaker: Reunion Member
content: You think this will end when we're dead?

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Even if they kill us, they won't let the children go. They won't let anyone go!
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Even if they kill us, they won't let the children go. They won't let anyone go!

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  If that's all it took, we'd gladly die to save the kids!
speaker: Reunion Member
content: If that's all it took, we'd gladly die to save the kids!

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  We didn't even attack you!
speaker: Reunion Member
content: We didn't even attack you!

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  Who's killing children...? The people in the black raincoats?
speaker: GreyThroat
content: Who's killing children...? The people in the black raincoats?

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  You've seen them, you understand! They're slaughtering everyone!
speaker: Reunion Member
content: You've seen them, you understand! They're slaughtering everyone!

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  That's no excuse. After I take you in, I will apply to have you protected.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: That's no excuse. After I take you in, I will apply to have you protected.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  And we're supposed to just trust you? That crossbow of yours is a killing tool, what are you protecting?
speaker: Reunion Member
content: And we're supposed to just trust you? That crossbow of yours is a killing tool, what are you protecting?

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  For now, I'm protecting your lives.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: For now, I'm protecting your lives.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Save it. We'll deal with you, then reset our trap!
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Save it. We'll deal with you, then reset our trap!

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  We've already got the order to form up and retreat. If we die here, it would dishonor those comrades who died to save their children!
speaker: Reunion Member
content: We've already got the order to form up and retreat. If we die here, it would dishonor those comrades who died to save their children!

speaker: GreyThroat
content: ...Child, take cover!

speaker: GreyThroat
content: Hm...

speaker: GreyThroat
content: I'm still alive?

raw: [name="???"]  You think you'd be better off dead?
content: You think you'd be better off dead?

speaker: GreyThroat
content: Operator Blaze?

raw: [name="Blaze"]  It's not like you dying would solve anything. Better keep on ticking.
speaker: Blaze
content: It's not like you dying would solve anything. Better keep on ticking.

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  What about... the Reunion men? And the children?
speaker: GreyThroat
content: What about... the Reunion men? And the children?

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Operator GreyThroat, I got you all wrong. And I'm sorry.
speaker: Blaze
content: Operator GreyThroat, I got you all wrong. And I'm sorry.

speaker: GreyThroat
content: The children!

raw: [name="Blaze"]  I took care of the Reunion guys! I hid the kids! Just listen to me already!
speaker: Blaze
content: I took care of the Reunion guys! I hid the kids! Just listen to me already!

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  No need... as long as the children are safe.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: No need... as long as the children are safe.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Can you not be obnoxious for like five minutes?
speaker: Blaze
content: Can you not be obnoxious for like five minutes?

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  What did you get wrong about me?
speaker: GreyThroat
content: What did you get wrong about me?

raw: [name="Blaze"]  I watched you stand up to fight for Infected kids. It was hella leng noi.
speaker: Blaze
content: I watched you stand up to fight for Infected kids. It was hella leng noi.

speaker: GreyThroat
content: Your Lungmen dialect sucks.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Hey, that's off the top of my head! But really, I thought you were just some heartless uninfected girl, joining Rhodes Island to spy on us or whatever. I got you all wrong.
speaker: Blaze
content: Hey, that's off the top of my head! But really, I thought you were just some heartless uninfected girl, joining Rhodes Island to spy on us or whatever. I got you all wrong.

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  If I were a spy, this is how I'd get you to trust me. As long as you weren't stupid enough to let me bleed out...
speaker: GreyThroat
content: If I were a spy, this is how I'd get you to trust me. As long as you weren't stupid enough to let me bleed out...

speaker: GreyThroat
content: You bandaged me?

raw: [name="Blaze"]  I'm still an elite operator. It's my job.
speaker: Blaze
content: I'm still an elite operator. It's my job.

speaker: Blaze
content: Anyway, you're right.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  But even if you were a spy, you still did the right thing. So I'll save this spy's life and then pack her off to Legal.
speaker: Blaze
content: But even if you were a spy, you still did the right thing. So I'll save this spy's life and then pack her off to Legal.

speaker: GreyThroat
content: I could just run.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Let's not be stupid here. How are you gonna outrun me?
speaker: Blaze
content: Let's not be stupid here. How are you gonna outrun me?

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Trust doesn't mean letting your guard down. Trust means knowing what you'll do and what you won't.
speaker: Blaze
content: Trust doesn't mean letting your guard down. Trust means knowing what you'll do and what you won't.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  If you do the right thing, I'll back you up. If you do the wrong thing, I'll correct it, or stop it, if I have to. That's trust.
speaker: Blaze
content: If you do the right thing, I'll back you up. If you do the wrong thing, I'll correct it, or stop it, if I have to. That's trust.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Thanks, GreyThroat. You trusted me, and you corrected my wrong thoughts with your right actions.
speaker: Blaze
content: Thanks, GreyThroat. You trusted me, and you corrected my wrong thoughts with your right actions.

speaker: Blaze
content: And I'm sorry.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  But you really need to work on your people skills. They didn't want to be difficult, that was a show for survival.
speaker: Blaze
content: But you really need to work on your people skills. They didn't want to be difficult, that was a show for survival.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  If you screw up, you still need to go to Legal.
speaker: Blaze
content: If you screw up, you still need to go to Legal.

speaker: GreyThroat
content: Whatever.

raw: [Decision(options="Well done!;......;Seems they're getting along better?", values="1;2;3")]
options: Well done!;......;Seems they're getting along better?

raw: [name="Amiya"]  I think so... at least Blaze is trying. Leave it to her to drop her prejudices so quickly.
speaker: Amiya
content: I think so... at least Blaze is trying. Leave it to her to drop her prejudices so quickly.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Rhodes Island's elite operators have more than just their incredible combat skills. Blaze is also gifted with a gregarious personality and savoir faire. As well as her own opinions.
speaker: Amiya
content: Rhodes Island's elite operators have more than just their incredible combat skills. Blaze is also gifted with a gregarious personality and savoir faire. As well as her own opinions.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  If you want to lead her, if you want her support, you'll have to gain her trust. And first, you have to learn how.
speaker: Amiya
content: If you want to lead her, if you want her support, you'll have to gain her trust. And first, you have to learn how.

speaker: Amiya
content: I've fought alongside Blaze for a long time. And I think... I think you can too, Doctor.

options: I'm doing okay.;......;She has to cooperate.

speaker: Amiya
content: But okay... isn't good enough, is it?

raw: [name="Amiya"]  She puts up a carefree front, but Blaze has a complicated personality.
speaker: Amiya
content: She puts up a carefree front, but Blaze has a complicated personality.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Give it time, keep your eyes open, and I know you can do it, Dr. {@nickname}.
speaker: Amiya
content: Give it time, keep your eyes open, and I know you can do it, Dr. {@nickname}.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  But you need to put in more work!
speaker: Amiya
content: But you need to put in more work!

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Learning to trust each other isn't easy, but it needs to be done.
speaker: Amiya
content: Learning to trust each other isn't easy, but it needs to be done.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  We need your power, Doctor, and you need to win over the operators to turn those tactics of yours into reality.
speaker: Amiya
content: We need your power, Doctor, and you need to win over the operators to turn those tactics of yours into reality.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  That's a lengthy process, but it's one you need to experience.
speaker: Amiya
content: That's a lengthy process, but it's one you need to experience.

content: Blaze is an elite operator who excels in assault operations. She doesn't have much to offer in the way of strategic thinking.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  She really needs your support. Or you could think of it like she'll turn your strategies into reality on the battlefield. She's a professional.
speaker: Amiya
content: She really needs your support. Or you could think of it like she'll turn your strategies into reality on the battlefield. She's a professional.

content: Like, look where we are now...

content: Our operators follow our orders out of a sense of duty, not trust.

speaker: Amiya
content: Real trust is built on understanding. The kind Blaze is working on with GreyThroat.

content: Oh...

speaker: Amiya
content: Looks like we've got company. More Reunion.

content: ...We will.

content: Listen up.
